# Glimmer Vale — OriginKit

Source: https://www.originkit.dev/components/glimmer-vale?preset=base

The component source was supplied by the project owner on 2026-10-23.
It is subject to OriginKit's custom license, not this project's MIT license:
https://www.originkit.dev/docs/licensing

OriginKit permits use and modification within applications, including open source
applications. Its terms restrict redistribution as standalone components,
templates, starter kits, and competing component libraries. Consult the original
license for the complete terms before reusing this portion separately.

Adaptations for this application: removed the React and DOM wrapper, exposed a
shared-clock renderer, reduced terrain/point counts and bloom levels, bounded
render resolution, replaced most foreground flowers with fine twinkling glints,
and isolated bloom from photos. The procedural shaders and
terrain implementation originate from OriginKit. No external images or fonts
are included.
